title: Oracle awarded 10-year $7 billion Pentagon deal to supply Department of War with vital software and services
summary: The US Department of War (DoW) has awarded Oracle with a near-$7 billion contract as part of the Arsenal of Freedom to supply the Department with enterprise software and services.
